_comment_run: The TUI always opens on the directory you launch it from.
_comment_presets: Add your own document presets here. They appear in the TUI preset picker (Settings -> 1) and in detection. The 'invoices' entry is a worked example; the TUI can generate one for you from a name + field list.

invoices.label: Invoices & receipts
invoices.description: Bills and receipts; vendor, invoice number, date and total.
invoices.vision_prompt:
Read this invoice or receipt and return ONLY JSON with exactly these keys:
{
  "vendor": "the vendor or merchant name",
  "invoice_number": "the invoice or receipt number, or \"\"",
  "date": "the invoice date as YYYY-MM-DD, or \"\"",
  "total": "the total amount including currency, or \"\"",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "needs_human": false
}

Base every value on what is printed on the page. Use an empty string when a value is missing. If the document is unreadable or ambiguous, set "needs_human": true. Output JSON only.
